description.value:
The base sealing pattern for binding a being of overwhelming chakra (a tailed beast, an Outer Path summon) into a living vessel.

Requirements 1 hour of uninterrupted ritual; a willing or unconscious vessel; the target being to be sealed.

The seal binds the target's chakra into the vessel. The vessel gains a special jinchūriki trait and the bound being's chakra reservoir; over time and with appropriate clan-feat investment, the vessel can draw on that chakra (the jinchūriki feature chain belongs to a future milestone).

The seal can be later strengthened (with a follow-up Eight Trigrams Sealing Style ritual, planned for a later milestone) or broken with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllFjContrcSeal]{Contract Seal} at a counteract rank of 7 or higher.

This is the canonical seal used by the Yondaime to bind half of Kurama into Naruto.
